title: Self-Attention to Operator Learning-based 3D-IC Thermal Simulation
problem: Efficient thermal simulation for 3D ICs with high power densities; traditional PDE-solving methods are accurate but computationally slow for iterative design workflows.
motivation: 3D IC thermal management is increasingly critical as power densities rise; existing ML approaches like Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) sacrifice high-frequency information fidelity and require extensive high-quality training data.
method: Self-Attention UNet Fourier Neural Operator (SAU-FNO) combines self-attention mechanisms with U-Net architecture and FNO to capture long-range dependencies and model local high-frequency features effectively. Transfer learning fine-tunes low-fidelity training data to reduce dependence on extensive high-fidelity datasets and accelerate training.
key_novelty: Hybrid architecture combining self-attention and U-Net with FNO to preserve high-frequency information while capturing long-range thermal dependencies via transfer learning on low-fidelity data.
contributions: SAU-FNO architecture integrating self-attention and U-Net with FNO for improved thermal modeling
Transfer learning approach enabling training with low-fidelity data
primary_theme: ML-based 3D IC thermal simulation via self-attention FNO and transfer learning
